mathematical_definition: max(0, close - prior_high_20) / close, where prior_high_20 = rolling(20).max(high) shifted by 1 bar -- how far (fractionally) the current close has broken above the prior, fully-resolved 20-bar high; 0 when no breakout
missing_value_policy: NaN for the first 21 bars (rolling(20).max needs 20 bars, plus the 1-bar shift to keep the compared level fully resolved before the current bar), never zero-filled
